name: Dufte Berlin
intro: A 1,000 m² culinary house of culture in the Kant-Garagenpalast, Europe's oldest surviving high-rise garage (1930), Charlottenburg: four kitchens, a bakery and café, two bars, a gallery and a 300 m² beer garden under one roof. Opened May 2026.
credit: Logo and brand identity by Plusminus Studio. Everything else, from concept, vendors and contracts to marketing, sales and day-to-day running, I led as Managing Director.

sections.title: My role
sections.text: As Geschäftsführer of Dufte Kraft GmbH I took Dufte from an empty garage floor to a venue with 450 guests on a busy night. What I was in charge of:

stats.label: indoor space, plus a 300 m² beer garden
spaces under one roof: 4 kitchens, bakery & café, 2 bars, gallery, beer garden
brands and organisers hosted for B2B events

points.title: Concept & business plan
points.text: The 'culinary house of culture' idea: no consumption minimum, no table service, art, music and events every week. Layouts, renderings and the plan behind them.

points.title: Vendor acquisition & leasing
points.text: Wrote the food vendor package, signed the five concepts (Mani in Pasta, Abuya, The Curried Cactus, Tacho, Domberger Brot-Werk) and negotiated the subleases and addenda.

points.title: Build-out & opening
points.text: Facade signage and neon, furniture, floor plan and the opening itself in May 2026.

points.title: Operations & systems
points.text: Lightspeed POS and cash rules for all tenants, opening hours, staffing set-up and revenue reporting across the vendors.

points.title: Marketing & communication
points.text: Pre-opening teasers, Open House events, Instagram launch, newsletter, website brief for dufteberlin.com and the press that followed.

points.title: Weekly programme
points.text: Formats like Kaffee Happy Hour, Tankrabatt Donnerstag, Freibier Freitag, Die Berliner Auster, Bingo, Kneipenquiz and comedy nights.

points.title: B2B events & sales
points.text: Event deck and sales for brand events, together with the 1,500 m² event loft on the 5th floor. Booked by Google, Hermès, Adidas × Zalando, Lululemon and more.

points.title: Investors & partners
points.text: Investor deck, landlord relations and the partnership with Better Life, who run the event loft.

sections.title: The building
sections.text: Dufte lives on the ground floor of the Kant-Garagenpalast: Europe's oldest surviving high-rise garage, built in 1930 in the Neue Sachlichkeit style and listed for its double-helix ramp. Concrete architecture meets a 300-element LED ceiling, eight audio zones and a south-facing beer garden, right on the S-Bahn tracks at Charlottenburg.

stats.label: built, a listed monument of Berlin Modernism
guests capacity on the ground floor

sections.title: Events & partners
sections.text: Dufte and the 1,500 m² event loft on the 5th floor are sold together as one venue for brand events, launches and shoots. Within the first months 17 brands and organisers booked it.

stats.label: event loft on the 5th floor, run with Better Life

sections.title: Brand & communication
sections.text: Logo, emblem and identity by Plusminus Studio. I carried it into everything guests touch, and ran the communication around it: pre-opening teasers, Open House events, the opening campaign, Instagram and the newsletter.

stats.label: weekly regulars, from Kaffee Happy Hour to Freibier Freitag
